name: Write embedded systems firmware and logic code
description: Users requested the creation, modification, or explanation of firmware and logic code for microcontrollers, FPGAs, and single-board computers, often involving specific hardware peripherals like sensors, displays, LEDs, and communication modules. The requests frequently involved porting code between platforms, implementing control algorithms, or writing drivers in languages such as C, C++, Verilog, and Arduino C++.
